title: One changed letter, a different fingerprint

sources.note: Python SHA-256 interface. Visuals are original explanations, not a recorded application run.

scenes.title: Give a file a fingerprint
scenes.narration: A hash gives these file bytes a short fingerprint.
scenes.action: Build the flow from file to SHA-256 to digest; highlight each stage in order.

scenes.title: Change the input
scenes.narration: Change the bytes, then calculate again. Compare the two digests to detect a change.
scenes.action: Keep the file object, move focus through the same pipeline and settle on compare.

scenes.title: Know the limit
scenes.narration: A hash alone does not prove who sent a file. Verify the expected digest through a trusted channel.
scenes.action: Keep the digest, reveal the trust check, settle on the distinction.
